name: Retro Arcade Jam
theme: Small browser games with an 80s arcade feel
invitationDescription: Two weekends, one cabinet. Build a browser game that would look at home in an 80s arcade and let a jury of makers play it.
brief:
Build a browser game in the spirit of the 80s arcades: one screen, instant to understand, hard to put down.

Rules:

- Any web framework, any assets you have the right to use.
- The game has to be playable with the keyboard alone.
- Ship it as a DojoCode project and submit it before the deadline. The copy taken at submit time is what the jury plays.

The jury scores every project on the criteria below. Ties go to the earlier submission.

criteria.label: Execution
criteria.description: Completeness and technical quality of the build.

criteria.label: Arcade feel
criteria.description: How well it channels the 80s cabinet.

criteria.label: Presentation
criteria.description: Clarity of the description and the walkthrough video.
